description: One delivery and its outcome. state is queued, provider_accepted (the network has it and is still processing), published (receipt.url is the live post), failed (error says why), unknown (the outcome could not be confirmed: do not send it again, read it again later) or cancelled.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

id.description: A delivery id from publish, schedule or jobs_list.
